newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pact to free up telecoms trade clinched in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: Pact to free up telecoms trade clinched in Geneva.

text.p: Some 68 countries on Saturday agreed to a landmark pact to open up the world's booming telecommunications trade to competition in a boost to the industry, diplomats said.
"It's been done," said one World Trade Organisation ambassador, emerging from the meeting.

Delegations inside the meeting hall clapped when WTO Committee Chairman Neil McMillan announced that an agreement was reached and ended the meeting just hours before a midnight Geneva deadline (2300 GMT) for an accord.

A Latin American trade ambassador said: "We've got an agreement. We are all very happy." A WTO official later emerged from the meeting to say: "It has been concluded successfully. The agreement is done."
U.S. Trade Representative designate Charlene Barshefsky will also announce the deal at a news conference in Washington at 1700 GMT, her office said.
